title: Senior Seminar; Empire and Nationalism in Russia: A Borderland Perspective
description: Examines empire-building processes under the Romanov dynasty's rule from Peter the Great (r. 1682-1725) through the First World War from the angle of tsarist Russia's multi-ethnic and multi-confessional composition. We will explore how the imperial state dealt with the rise of nationalism in Russia's western, southern, and eastern borderlands.
